mechanisms.operation: Unchanged frozen engine, raw drive33 and published Pulse output. Reuse exact earlier raw WAV for this depth/attack context.

Replace the global overdrive pre-gain maximum law32dB with16dB: pow(10,(drive/127)*(16/20)). Retain the same compensation formula preGain^-0.4, recomputed from this experimental preGain. No SysEx drive mutation; all enabled overdrive uses this diagnostic mapping.
mechanisms.caveat: This changes both nonlinear curvature and small-signal gain; at drive33 pre-gain changes8.315 to4.157dB and compensation is recomputed. This is not raw drive16 and not a gain-matched linearization.

mechanisms.operation: Replace enabled tanh transfer by identity while retaining preGain(raw33), compensation(raw33), oversampling filters, history handling, latency and ADAA half-sample averaging. Identity ADAA output is (current_input+previous_input)/2 at the existing internal rate, then previous_input=current_input.
mechanisms.caveat: Do not substitute OD-off delayed bypass: that would also remove small-signal gain and resampling/ADAA response.

mechanisms.operation: For PulseSquare only, subtract analytic mean 2*duty-1 from corrected oscillator output before mixing/filtering; preserve duty, BLEP, phase, waveform AC scale, Square, and every other waveform.
mechanisms.caveat: Subtraction changes startup/DC transients as well as the nonlinear operating point. The paired linearizedADAA control distinguishes these effects.

mechanisms.operation: Apply the preceding identity-ADAA and analytic Pulse-mean subtraction together, with all other operations unchanged.

Advance AMP envelope exactly once/sample at the original time; multiply filtered input by envelopeNow before the enabled OD chain and remove its delayed post-OD multiplication. Preserve level/velocity/pan, compensation, envelope law and note lifecycle/transport bookkeeping.
mechanisms.caveat: AMP-envelope order only, not all AMP gains. Lower is OD-bypassed; preserve its output exactly or verify its matched-delay linear equivalence if the transformation is applied generically.

inferences: Within the frozen software topology, changing pulse mean has large late-shape effects with nonlinear OD and almost none with matched linearized OD; this is evidence of DC-dependent nonlinear regeneration in this model, not proof of the hardware topology.

Matched linearized OD at temporary depth−32 approaches late H3/H2/H4/H2, but misses H2/H1, first-note powers and closure times; the adjoining-gate fourth note starts already dark. Endpoint proximity does not establish a match.

No one of the eight sampled original-patch phases overlaps the hardware marginal H3/H2 or H4/H2 ranges. This bounded check does not exclude unsampled phases, other reset/history behavior or interactions with altered mechanisms.
limitations: Linearizing OD removes its level-dependent compression as well as harmonics; it is an identity-transfer diagnostic with matched small-signal gain/resampling/ADAA delay, not a measured hardware algorithm.
Pulse centering subtracts an instantaneous analytic mean; it is not an analog DC blocker and also changes startup/RMS. The paired linearized control helps expose that confound.
The16dB maximum drive law recomputes the existing pre^-0.4 compensation and changes Upper gain relative to Lower. Moving AMP envelope changes nonlinear excitation, but leaves other gain stages fixed.

H1 combines Upper and Lower and can cancel with phase. H3/H2 and H4/H2 avoid that denominator only under clean approximately stationary Lower sine, linear unclipped summation/output and reliable finite-window fitting.

Upper Square/Pulse relative phase, unknown hardware control edits, capture processing, velocity and gate history remain unresolved. First-note windows are time-varying periodic projections, not steady spectra.
Raw amplitudes and powers use uncalibrated capture gain. Window/channel/encode observations are sensitivity checks on one performance, not independent samples or confidence intervals.
No different-patch confirmation or unseen validation was performed for these mechanisms. No production code was changed or shipping candidate selected.
